changes: Replace the long tracking transaction with an expiring owner-token lease; release each database connection before waiting for a carrier response.
Renew ownership before and after provider reads, recover after a crashed worker lease expires and prevent an expired owner from releasing a replacement worker's lease.
Check the worker token again under shipment/order row locks using the actual clock, including expiry after a transaction has already started.
Keep the existing atomic delivery/order/commission transition, terminal-state protection, return exclusions, query interval and director-only manual query permissions.
Stop applying late observations during shutdown and mask provider/connection details in control notes.
Refresh the visible shipping workspace from the local API every 30 seconds without creating or resubmitting shipments; skip hidden tabs, overlapping reads and active operations.
Preserve filters and open history during background refresh, retain last records on read failure, disable stale actions and recover on the next successful refresh.
Validate shipment-history identity, add an explicit history refresh action and show when the opened history was read.

verification.database_scope: Actual migration 082 applied twice, real tracking service and real shipping transition service with a single isolated SQL connection. Carrier responses were controlled fixtures.
sql_scenarios: Verified delivery updates order and exact tracking number
No open transaction during provider I/O
Late old owner cannot overwrite or release new owner
Repeated delivery creates no duplicate history
Cancellation and shutdown while provider read is pending
verification.commission_scope: Existing award hook checked in the shipping unit suite; no real commission or payment was created.

deployment_requirement: Apply migration 082 before starting the new API. Deploy the updated panel to obtain background list refresh and history refresh controls.
limitations: The free in-process carrier schedule still requires an awake API process; no paid scheduler or compute plan was added.
The existing batch limit and five-minute carrier query interval remain unchanged. The 30-second screen refresh reads stored API data and does not call Aras directly.
manual_checks_pending: After deployment, verify a real delivered shipment's tracking number, delivered tab and commission finalization using separate manager/director sessions.
Browser layout review of history refresh controls.
